content: {"argument": "The change modifies the condition from checking if the array length is greater than zero to greater than -1, which evaluates to true for empty arrays (length 0 > -1). This causes the keep-query-parameters loop to execute even when the array is empty, resulting in all query parameters being deleted because no parameter passes the testParameter check. However, the intended behavior for an empty keepQueryParameters array is to keep all query parameters, not remove them. Therefore, this change introduces a regression by inverting the logic.", "concedes": true}
